answer_html:
Definition

A Java web framework is a ready-made structure of libraries that makes building web applications faster and cleaner than writing raw servlets and JSP.

Advantages

  • Follow MVC, so code is organised.
  • Less repeated (boilerplate) code.
  • Built-in security, validation, database support.
FrameworkKey idea
Spring MVC / Spring BootMVC, dependency injection, auto configuration
StrutsAction-based MVC
JSFComponent-based UI, event driven
HibernateORM: Java objects ↔ database tables
OthersPlay, Grails, Vaadin
